'''Alirra Semhess''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. Following the death of the [[Eternal Empire]] Empress [[Vaylin]] and the formation of the [[Eternal Alliance]] in [[3631 BBY]], she led a rogue group of Republic scientists to work on a secret project on the [[X7-Cratus]] space station. Falsely obtaining funding from a Republic endowment for disease research and treatment development, the group instead worked on developing experimental adrenals. Doctor [[Rahser Poth]] received encrypted communications fron an anonymous scientist that allowed him to develop [[RAK-5 serum]], which in turn was refined into [[RS-33]] adrenal.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|type=codex|Alliance Intelligence Report: RS-33 Adrenal}}</ref> The adrenal greatly enhanced subject's strength and agility at the expense of metal faculties, but in truth both RAK-5 and RS-33 were derived from the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]], which put them into highly unstable state.<ref name="SWTOR" />

Eternal Alliance operatives under [[Theron Shan]] eventually discovered Semhess and her project and a strike team was [[Attack on the X7-Cratus|dispatched]] to X7-Cratus to stop RS-33 from becoming a galactic threat. Semhess attempted to use RS-33 enhanced subjects to stop the invaders, but during their fight with [[Marlon Fenn]] the station's containment systems were damaged and RAK-5 serum started leaking into atmosphere. It soon turned both RS-33 test subjects and personnel such as [[Icarr Ko]] and [[Nyris Ko]] into [[Rakghoul]]s. When the Alliance strike team reached Alirra Semhess herself, she blamed the contanimation on them and tried to fight them off, but succumbed to the infection and turned into rakghoul herself. After killing her new form, the Eternal Alliance secured the station's containment systems and put an end to the project.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Alirra Semhess appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as the final boss of the "Trial and Error" Uprising.
